top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon arrival a 2 yr old was observed watching videos on Youtube

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection available.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Copy of the most current sanitation inspection report was not available to review at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The incident report was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken
